content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: heavy payments overtime plus chat deflection on both queues lifts service level to 73.2% for 12:30-14:30, still short of the 80% target, at ₹14,148.","why":"The drop is caused by system slowness, not extra calls. P2 incident INC-20261102-2029 is freezing core banking screens, and payments handle time has risen to 561 s against a forecast of about 295 s. Volume, call mix and absences are all normal. Doing nothing leaves 12:30-14:30 at 32.8% (payments 19.1%), with 20.2% of calls abandoned. No plan reaches 80% in this window, so R1 was chosen as the best available. It predicts 73.2% overall (payments 70.2%, general 77.1%), cuts abandons to 6.8%, and lifts the rest of the day to 89.6%. It offers overtime to 55 payments agents for 13:00-14:00 and 25 for 14:00-15:00. It also deflects 20% of selected enquiry types to chat on both queues, delays payments breaks by 45 min, and offers IVR callbacks on payments.","trade_offs":["R2 costs the same (₹14,148) and gives the same 73.2% overall with no break delays. It favours payments (73.7%) but leaves general lower (72.7% vs 77.1%) and abandons slightly higher (7.2% vs 6.8%).","P4 is ₹816 cheaper (₹13,332) but reaches only 66.0% with 8.5% abandons. P3 (₹8,640) reaches 55.1%. The no-cost options P0 and P1 stay around 32%.","R1 depends on about 55 agents accepting overtime in the 13:00 hour. If fewer accept, payments service will fall back towards the P4/P3 levels."],"watch":"Track overtime acceptance before 13:00 and payments handle time against the incident. If INC-20261102-2029 is resolved early, scale back the 14:00-15:00 overtime. If it worsens or overtime uptake is low, expect payments to stay well below 70%."}
